description: Rollback a project to a previous version. ⚠️ WARNING: This reverts schema AND code to the specified commit. Database data is NOT rolled back. Use get_version_history to find the commit SHA of the version you want to rollback to. After rollback, use get_job_status to monitor the redeployment. Rollback is useful when a schema change breaks deployment. One operation runs on a project at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
